provenance.prompt:
Create one scientific-educational Dino Atlas S2 color-and-pattern candidate, never a representative replacement. Use the supplied project-owned Coelodonta antiquitatis representative only for species identity, coat volume, shoulder height and horn geometry. Do not copy its full-body side-view composition.

Use a portrait-oriented 4:5 vertical composition: a deliberate head-and-high-shoulder study of exactly one Coelodonta antiquitatis from a low front-left three-quarter camera, about thirty degrees away from straight frontal. Crop intentionally below the chest and shoulder so that no partial legs enter the frame; this image makes no full-body or limb-count claim. Keep the complete skull, both small ears, exactly two midline horns and both horn tips fully inside the frame.

The anterior nasal horn must be a long laterally compressed keratin blade, much taller dorsoventrally than it is thick side-to-side. Show one broad planar lateral face and the very narrow top/front edge at the same time, with transverse growth bands across the broad face. Behind it place exactly one much smaller posterior horn. Preserve a low broad head, small ears, high withers, modest shoulder-neck hump and dense double-layered wool.

Use a distinct hypothetical coat variation: cold charcoal undercoat with irregular pale cream frost-tipped guard-hair patches across the brow, cheek and high shoulder, never regular stripes or repeated spots. A calm plume of visible breath drifts sideways into open negative space while a crosswind lifts loose guard hairs. Late Pleistocene cold dry steppe at blue-white dawn, softly blurred background, no aggression.

Reject any round or conical modern-rhinoceros horn, one horn, three or more horns, tusks, trunk, bison hump, hairless modern rhinoceros skin, cropped horn tip, duplicated facial features, extra animal, accidental partial limbs, full-body side silhouette, text, label, logo, watermark, external artwork imitation or named-artist style.

The intentional below-chest crop makes no limb-count claim. Representative promotion prohibited.
